title: Italian Skillet Brie Frittata
description: A simple Italian-inspired frittata made with brie cheese, perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped parsley and cook for another minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the brie cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
Optional: sprinkle with zesty for extra flavor.
